correctness.rationale: Condition on the three assigned images. Each of the three forced edges removes one vertex in total when deleting fully forced cycles and contracting open paths. The remaining out- and in-stubs correspond to the same n-3 blocks, whose completions are uniform permutations, adding H_{n-3} to the expected forced-cycle count G. This works even at n=3. With D=n(n-1)(n-2), D E[G]=3n(n-2)+2. Fixed-point counts at source s are binom(n-s,2), (s-1)(n-s), or binom(s-1,2) according to the assigned rank. The swaps of the first two, outer two, and last two positions respectively contribute n-a-1 to 213, n-a-2 to 231 and a-1 to 312, and a to 132; all other completions of those swaps have pattern 321. Only 231 and 312 have forced three-cycles. Thus 6D Cov=6(F+M+J)-3n(n-2)-2, giving the four affine numerators; conjugation by order reversal also pairs 132 with 213 and 231 with 312 at the reflected start n-a-1. At n=3 the numerators in the original order are 1,-5,1,-5, as follows also from the cycle counts of the six permutations. The denominators are positive, the affine signs and n^2-scaled limits follow, and summing the two rows of either orientation pair gives -4/(6D). The zeros of the affine functions need not be admissible integer starts. The frozen verification files were read, not executed; their finite tests supplement the all-size proof.
